scientific_scope: Prospective candidate-class decision after permanent P2-v1 closure. This record selects only the next independently motivated painted-trail response class for internal development. It does not define an executable P3 mechanism, set P3 parameters, authorize simulation, access the response target, or unlock Y-maze validation.

p2_closure_boundary.rule: P2-v1 closure is used only to establish that P2 is closed. P2 target-ranked fold outcomes may not choose P3 equations, sensor geometry, parameter values, bounds, seeds, budgets, folds, weights, objectives, or promotion thresholds.

independent_evidence_inputs.title: Individual rules for trail pattern formation in Argentine ants
evidence: Individual turning responded to local pheromone concentration.
Moving speed was largely unaffected by pheromone concentration.
The reported turning response followed a Weber-like relative bilateral rule based on side-to-side difference divided by their sum.
The reported response was local rather than a long temporal integration of pheromone concentration.
independent_evidence_inputs.allowed_inference: Relative or normalized bilateral pheromone transduction is a biologically documented ant trail-response class suitable for a separate development hypothesis.
limits: This is cross-species evidence and does not establish that Lasius niger uses the same exact rule.
It cannot set Lasius niger parameter values, sensor spacing, regularization constants, gains, or search bounds.

independent_evidence_inputs.title: Pheromone trail following is not modulated by previous visit to food location, distance travelled, or travel direction in the ant Lasius niger
evidence: Painted-trail following was robust in Lasius niger.
No significant modulation was detected for prior path distance, travel direction, or recent food experience across the tested conditions.
independent_evidence_inputs.allowed_inference: A next trail-response class should remain shared across those context variables unless new independent evidence supports context-specific modulation.
limits: This source does not identify a Weber-like transduction equation.
It cannot be used to fit P3 parameters before a prospective estimation policy exists.

independent_evidence_inputs.role: Preserves the pre-P2 independent evidence comparison in which relative/Weber bilateral transduction was already recorded as a plausible but unselected future class.

selected_next_candidate_class.description: A local painted-trail steering response whose sensory transduction depends on normalized or relative left-right pheromone contrast rather than the P1/P2 fixed saturating absolute-transduction difference.
selection_rationale: The class was independently documented before P2-v1 outcomes existed.
It changes the sensory transduction structure rather than retuning P2's transient engagement probability.
The cited empirical mechanism changes turning while leaving speed largely unaffected, matching the project firewall against inventing pheromone-driven speed changes.
It does not require path-length, travel-direction, recent-experience, colony-specific, or stable-specialist response parameters.
selected_next_candidate_class.biological_claim_limit: Selection for internal model development is not a claim that Lasius niger has been shown to implement Weber-law transduction.

mechanism_details_deliberately_not_froze: estimation objective, folds, seeds, budgets, and promotion rules
next_mechanism_freeze_requirements: Freeze the exact transduction equation before implementation.
Define behavior at zero or near-zero bilateral concentration without using target-ranked outcomes.
Freeze sensor geometry and any engineering-only values before simulation.
Preserve canonical speed, pauses, angular-noise amplitude, contacts, and biology RNG unless independently changed by a separate gate.
Define exact canonical or nested null identities.
Prove rotation, translation, endpoint reversal, local steering sign, and zero-signal invariances reference-free.
Do not include P2 transient engagement in P3-v1 unless a later independent evidence gate separately authorizes a combined mechanism.
Do not access response-target semantics or Y-maze before later qualification/authorization gates.
next_gate: Create a separate P3 mechanism-selection/freeze record that specifies the exact relative bilateral transduction, null identities, invariances, structural parameters, and reference-free engineering reachability panel before any P3 implementation or simulation.
